y-m-12-05.title: Ma laba xariiq oo aan kulmin waa barbar socda?
y-m-12-05.topic: Laba xariiq oo barbar socda (masaafada u dhexaysa xariiqyada barbar socda)
y-m-12-05.goal: Fahan in aan la kulmin gudaha warqadda aysan ku filnayn in lagu xaqiijiyo barbar-socod, hagaajina go'aankaaga adigoo tixgelinaya khaladka cabbiridda masaafada.
y-m-12-05.material: Xariiq 가 iyo xariiq 나 waxay ku sawiran yihiin warqad. Waxaad rabtaa inaad ogaato in labada xariiq ay barbar socdaan. Masaafada u dhexaysa laba xariiq oo barbar socda waa dhererka la cabbiray si toosan xariiq 가, waana isku mid meel kasta oo la cabbiro. Ka qaad in cabbiridda xarig leh ay leedahay khalad ku dhawaad 0.2 cm. Cabbir masaafada meelo 5 cm u jira xariiq 가 dhinaceeda. Sawirka lama muujin.

y-m-12-05.thinking.1: Kala sooca khaladka cabbiridda iyo farqi dhab ah
y-m-12-05.thinking.2: Dooridda siyaabo ka dhigaya caddaynta mid adag
y-m-12-05.prereq.0: Barbar-socod: laba xariiq oo aan weligood kulmin inkasta oo la sii dheereeyo
y-m-12-05.prereq.1: Masaafada u dhexaysa laba xariiq oo barbar socda waa isku mid meel kasta oo la cabbiro
y-m-12-05.prereq.2: Cabbiridda dherer adoo isticmaalaya xarig (khalad yar ayaa dhaca)
y-m-12-05.s.s1.prompt: Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa qayb qayb. Mar kasta, dooro waxa aad u malaynayso.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tallaabo kasta, kala sooc waxa xogta cusubi ku siiso 'hubaal' iyo waxa kuu oggolaanaya inaad kaliya 'qiyaasto'.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.hint.1: Si aad u tiraahdo in masaafooyinku isku mid yihiin ku dhawaad, barbar dhig farqiga iyo khaladka 0.2 cm.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Gudaha warqadda, labada xariiq ma kulmaan. Ma sii dheereyn kartid xariiqyada ka dib geeska warqadda.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma odhan karnaa labada xariiq waa barbar socdaan?
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Aan la kulmin gudaha warqadda kuma filna. Haddii aad xariiqyada sii dheereyso, way kulmi karaan. Waxaad u baahan tahay hab hubin ah (cabbiridda masaafooyinka, hubinta isbarbar-taagga).
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Barbar socda. Ma kulmaan, markaa waa barbar socdaan
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Ma kulmaan gudaha warqadda' iyo 'weligood ma kulmaan inkasta oo la sii dheereeyo' way kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Weli ma go'aamin karno. Way kulmi karaan ka baxsan warqadda, markaa waxaan u baahanahay inaan ku hubino hab kale
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad kala soocday waxa u muuqda iyo waxa lagu xaqiijiyay xaqiiqo.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma barbar socdaan. Haddii aad xariiqyada u dheereyso ilaa ay ku filan yihiin, had iyo jeer way kulmaan
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xariiqyada barbar socda weligood ma kulmaan inkasta oo la sii dheereeyo.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Lama ogaan karo. Hab hubin ah majiro
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Waxaa jira siyaabo lagu hubin karo cabbiridda masaafooyinka ama hubinta isbarbar-taagga.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Waxaan cabbiray masaafada u dhexaysa labada xariiq saddex meelood oo 5 cm u jira xariiq 가 dhinaceeda, waxaanan helay 4.0 cm, 4.1 cm, 4.0 cm.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii masaafooyinka saddexda meelood ay isku mid yihiin gudaha xadka khaladka, fursadda ay barbar socdaan way kordhaysaa. Laakiin saddex meelood oo keliya ayaa jira, markaa 'cabbir wax badan ka dibna go'aami' sidoo kale waa ku habboon yahay. Labada go'aan labaduba waxay leeyihiin sabab.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waxay isku mid yihiin gudaha xadka khaladka, markaa waxaan u malaynayaa inay u badan tahay inay barbar socdaan
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah in farqiga 0.1 cm uu ka yar yahay khaladka (ku dhawaad 0.2 cm).
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 4.1 ayaa soo baxay, markaa waxaan gabagabeynayaa inayan barbar socon
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Farqiga 0.1 cm waa gudaha xadka khaladka. Farqi cabbirkan le'eg, way adag tahay in lagu gabagabeeyo inayan barbar socon.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Saddex meelood oo keliya ayaan cabbiray, markaa ma go'aamin doono in ay barbar socdaan ilaa aan wax badan cabbiro
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad tilmaantay in xogtu yar tahay. Qorshaynta in wax dheeraad ah la ururiyo ka hor go'aaminta sidoo kale waa go'aan ku habboon.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Masaafooyinku waa isku mid, markaa labada xariiq waa isla xariiq
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Haddii masaafadu tahay ku dhawaad 4 cm, waa laba xariiq oo kala duwan.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Saaxiib ayaa sawiray laba xariiq oo kale, 다 iyo 라, waxaanan u cabbiray si isku mid ah, masaafooyinkuna waxay ahaayeen 4.0 cm, 4.6 cm, 5.2 cm. Waxay kala fogaanayaan 0.6 cm 5 cm kasta.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maxaad ka fikirtaa 다 iyo 라?
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Farqigu wuu ka weyn yahay khaladka wuxuuna sii kordhayaa hal jiho, markaa waa ku habboon tahay in la mooyo inayan barbar socon. Haddii aad ka walaacsan tahay fursadda khaladka, mar kale cabbiridda si loo hubiyo sidoo kale waa wanaagsan. Haddii aad u socoto dhinaca masaafadu yaraanayso, maalin bay kulmi doonaan.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Farqi aad uga weyn khaladka (ku dhawaad 0.2 cm) ayaa sii soo muuqda isla jihada, markaa waxaan u malaynayaa inayan barbar socon
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad isticmaashay labadaba in farqigu weyn yahay iyo in jihadiisu go'an tahay.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Qiimayaasha la cabbiray waxay leeyihiin khalad, markaa waxaan ka tagayaa inay laga yaabo inay barbar socdaan
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 0.6 cm waa saddex jeer khaladka 0.2 cm. Intaa waxaa dheer, farqigu wuu sii kordhayaa hal jiho.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kadib cabbiridda isla meelahaas mar kale si loo hubiyo, haddii ay isku mid tahay, waxaan u malaynayaa inayan barbar socon
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waa ku habboon tahay sababtoo ah waa qorshe lagu hubinayo in cabbiriddu khaldanayd. Haddii aad mar kale cabbirto oo aad hesho isla qiimaha, go'aankaagu wuu isku mid noqon doonaa.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Haddii aad sii socoto dhinaca ay kala fogaadaan, labada xariiq way kulmaan
y-m-12-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Dhinaca ay kala fogaadaan, masaafadu way sii weynaataa oo ma is-dhowaadaan. Ka fikir dhinaca masaafadu yaraanayso.
y-m-12-05.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii waxaad ka bilowday 'ma go'aamin karo', xogta labaad 'fursadda barbar-socod' way kacday, xogta saddexaadna go'aankaagu wuxuu u beddelmay dhinaca kale 'ma barbar socdaan'. Fiiro gaar ah: inkastoo xogta lagu helay isla hab, go'aankaagu wuu is beddelay iyadoo ku xiran in farqigu ka weyn yahay ama ka yar yahay khaladka.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.prompt: Immisa ka mid ah hababkan soo socda ayaa ka dhigaya caddaynta in 가 iyo 나 ay barbar socdaan mid adag? Dooro dhammaan kuwa ku habboon.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.hint.0: Xusuuso sifada run ah ee ay tahay inay lahaadaan xariiqyada barbar socda.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir in hab kastaa uu sifeeyo kiisaska 'si kedis ah u muuqda barbar socod'.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.o.a: Ku eeg indhahaaga muddo dheer oo dareen in ay u muuqdaan barbar socod
y-m-12-05.s.s2.r.a: Dareen ka yimid eegis waa caddayn daciif ah. Indhahaaga waa lagu khiyaaneyn karaa.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.r.b: Meelaha badan ee aad cabbirto, ayaad badan sifayn kartaa khaladka ama kedisnimada hal ama laba meelood.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.o.c: Sawir hal xariiq oo mara 가 iyo 나 labadaba, kuna hubi gees-qaabeeye (set square) in labada xagal ay yihiin xaglo qumman
y-m-12-05.s.s2.r.c: Waxaad isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah in laba xariiq oo hal xariiq ku taagan si toosan ay barbar socdaan.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.o.d: Hubi in labada xariiq ay isku dhumuc yihiin
y-m-12-05.s.s2.explain: Kordhinta meelaha aad cabbirto iyo hubinta in labaduba hal xariiq ku taagan yihiin si toosan ayaa ka dhigaya caddaynta barbar-socodka mid adag. Dareen indhaha ama dhumucda waxay kaliya si daciif ah ula xiriiraan barbar-socodka.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.acc.0: Kordhinta meelaha aad cabbirto oo keliya ayaa ka dhigaysa caddaynta mid adag. Hubinta isbarbar-taagga sidoo kale ayaa ka sii wanaagsan.
y-m-12-05.s.s2.acc.1: Hubinta isbarbar-taagga oo keliya waa caddayn barbar-socod. Ku darista cabbiridda ayaa ka sii wanaagsan.

y-m-12-01.title: Halbeeg-xagaleedku wuxuu leeyahay laba saf oo calaamado ah oo wuu qasayaa
y-m-12-01.topic: Cabbirka cabbirka xagal adigoo isticmaalaya halbeeg-xagaleed (akhrinta laba saf oo calaamado ah)
y-m-12-01.goal: Hel halbeeg lagu go'aamiyo tirada laga akhriyo labada saf ee calaamadaha ee halbeeg-xagaleedka, oo sax akhrin khaldan adigoo ku hubinaya cabbir la qiyaasay.
y-m-12-01.material: Minjae wuxuu ku cabbirayaa cabbirka xagalka ㅅㅇㅈ (시옷 이응 지읒), oo warqad lagu sawiray, halbeeg-xagaleed. Wuxuu bartamaha halbeeg-xagaleedka la jaanqaadsiiyay fiiqda ㅇ, dhinaca ㅇㅅ na wuxuu la jaanqaadsiiyay calaamadda 0° ee midigta ee halbeeg-xagaleedka. Marka la eego halka dhinaca ㅇㅈ maro, calaamadaha waxaa lagu akhriyi karaa laba saf. Akhrinta safka ka bilaabma 0° midig waxay siinaysaa 65, akhrinta safka ka bilaabma 0° bidix na waxay siinaysaa 115. Xagalkani wuxuu u muuqdaa mid ka cidhiidhsan xagal-qumman (geeska xagal-qumman ee seto-isku-xigeen). Sawirka lama muujin, sidaas darteed qiyaas meelaha erayada lagu sharaxay.
y-m-12-01.thinking.1: Hubinta natiijada adigoo qiyaasaya (barbar dhigidda xagal-qumman)
y-m-12-01.thinking.2: Hubinta in marka xaaladdu is beddesho, isla habku wuxuu bixiyaa natiijo kala duwan

Dhinaca ㅇㅅ wuxuu la jaanqaadsiiyay 0° midig, sidaas darteed waa inaad akhrido safka ka bilaabma 0° midig, tanna sidoo kale waxay waafaqsan tahay qiyaasta xagalka inuu ka cidhiidhsan yahay xagal-qumman. Safka 5 waa natiijo qaadata qaladka safka 4.

y-m-12-13.title: Bisha ugu sarreysa iyo bisha leh kororka ugu weyn

y-m-12-04.goal: Isbarbar dhig, sida sabab looga hadlayo 'dhammaan shaxanka', xogta lagu helay cabbirid iyo sharaxaad lagu helay kala qaybinta shaxanka, go'aami kee ka habboon, kuna dabaq isla habka shax cusub.
y-m-12-04.material: Sua iyo Junho waxay ka hadlayaan in 'isku-darka afarta xagal ee afar-geesood uu yahay 360°' uu sax yahay dhammaan afar-geesoodyada. Ka fikir kaliya afar-geesoodyada aan lahayn god gudaha u socda. Sua: 'Waxaan protractor ku cabbiray 5 afar-geesood oo isku darnay afarta xagal, waxaana helnay 359°, 361°, 360°, 362°, 358°. Markaa isku-darka afar-geesood kasta waa 360°.' Junho: 'Haddii aad hal xagal-jar ku xidho afar-geesood, wuxuu u kala baxaa laba saddex-geesood. y-m-12-04.thinking.2: Ballaarinta habka aad taqaanid ee shax cusub

y-m-12-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir hal afar-geesood oo kale oo ku tijaabi sharaxaadda Junho si aad u aragto inay sida ay tahay loo isticmaali karo afar-geesood kasta.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.a: Sharaxaadda Sua ayaa ka wanaagsan. Iyadu laftigeedu waxay cabbirtay shan afar-geesood oo natiijooyinka oo dhan waxay ahaayeen ku dhawaad 360°
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.a: Cabbiriddu waa hubin qiimo leh, laakiin way adag tahay in la yiraahdo dhammaan afar-geesoodyada waa isku mid sababtoo ah shan ayaa la cabbiray. Waxaa harsan fursad ah in afar-geesoodka xiga uu ka duwan yahay.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.b: Labada sharaxaad waa isku heer sabab. Labaduba waxay sheegayaan isla natiijada, in isku-darku yahay 360°
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.b: Xitaa haddii natiijooyinku isku mid yihiin, in ay muujinayaan 'sababta ay sidaas u tahay' way ku kala duwan yihiin. Isbarbar dhig sharaxaadda sida ay tahay loo isticmaali karo afar-geesood cusub.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.c: Midkoodna sabab ma aha. Ma cabbiri kartid dhammaan afar-geesoodyada, sharaxaaduna sidoo kale waa dhawr tusaale oo keliya
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.c: Xitaa haddii aadan cabbiri karin dhammaan, sharaxaad sabab leh waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad ka hadasho dhammaan kiisaska hal mar. Eeg in sharaxaadda Junho ay sidaas tahay.

y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.c: Sharaxaadda Junho waa sharaxaad sabab leh, markaa way adag tahay in isla markiiba la yiraahdo waa khalad sababtoo ah dhawr qiimo oo la cabbiray ayaa yar ku kala duwan.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.o.d: Cabbiridda protractor waa inay had iyo jeer siisaa 360° si sax ah, markaa qiime kasta oo aan ahayn 360° waa lagu cabbiray si khaldan
y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.d: Farqiyada ka timaadda akhrinta calaamadaha way caadi yihiin. Waxay u badan tahay khalad halkii ay noqon lahayd cabbirid khaldan.

Laakiin ma gabagabayn kartid 'si sax ah 360°' cabbirid oo keliya, markaa sharaxaad sabab leh sidoo kale waa loo baahan yahay.

y-m-12-06.title: Ma shax la rogay waa isla shaxda la wareejiyay?
